commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Jose Munuera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Chimy Avila (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Jose Munuera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Chimy Avila (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Peque (Sevilla) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Pablo Fornals makes way for Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis).
90' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Cucho Hernandez will be replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).

89' Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
89' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

89' The match can continue after the interruption.
88' The game is interrupted.
86' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Marcao (Sevilla) is the recipient.
84' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) takes out his opponent after failing to control himself and the referee has no choice but to show him a deserved red card!
83' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' The ball is cleared after Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.

81' Valentin Gomez (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement. Sevilla win a free kick.
81' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' It's time for a substitution. Miguel Sierra (Sevilla) comes on in place of Chidera Ejuke.
79' Akor Adams (Sevilla) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
78' The attendance for today's match is 42580.
77' Pablo Fornals (Betis) will take a corner kick.
75' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
74' Akor Adams (Sevilla) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
72' Pablo Garcia goes off the pitch and Angel Ortiz (Betis) comes on.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.

71' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
71' Sevilla have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Djibril Sow walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla).
68' 0 - 2 Goal! Sergi Altimira (Betis) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 0:2.

68' The game is interrupted. Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. That's a free kick to Betis.
67' Marc Roca (Betis) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

66' Pablo Fornals (Betis) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
65' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) commits a rough foul. Jose Munuera stops the game and makes a call.
63' The substitution is prepared. Sergi Altimira (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nelson Deossa.

61' Matias Almeyda has decided to substitute Alfonso Gonzalez and he is replaced by Isaac Romero (Sevilla).
58' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
57' Superb touch by Pablo Garcia (Betis) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save!
56' The free kick from long range, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

54' 0 - 1 Pablo Fornals (Betis) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Odysseas Vlachodimos is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
54' Peque (Sevilla) controls a nice lofted pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but his attempt is neither hard nor precise, so Alvaro Valles stops it easily.
53' Peque (Sevilla) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
52' Jose Munuera shows a yellow card to Aitor Ruibal (Betis) for his blatant foul.
50' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sevilla, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

48' Nelson Deossa (Betis) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle. Sevilla are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' Matias Almeyda has made a change at the break. Kike Salas has come on in place of Marcao (Sevilla).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Marc Bartra (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Munuera had an easy-decision to make.
41' It looks like Marcao (Sevilla) saw red with that tackle. Jose Munuera won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
39' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.

37' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the roof of the net, but is thwarted by a great save from Odysseas Vlachodimos.
36' Peque (Sevilla) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
34' Marc Bartra (Betis) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
32' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Djibril Sow (Sevilla), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
30' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 4:7.
27' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
26' The referee blows his whistle as Pablo Garcia (Betis) was too aggressive in his challenge.
21' Marc Roca (Betis) is penalised for holding. Jose Munuera signals a set piece.
20' Pablo Garcia (Betis) loses the defending players and unloads a powerful, but inaccurate effort from long distance. The goalkeeper remains completely calm as the ball ends somewhere in row Z.
19' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
14' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Natan (Betis) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
11' Pablo Fornals (Betis) prepares to take a corner kick.
10' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes a short free kick.
9' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Rough tackle by Cucho Hernandez (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Dangerous play by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla). Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Pablo Fornals (Betis) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Odysseas Vlachodimos, who smothers the ball.
